# Draft:Use of Vernonia amygdalina (Bitter Leaf) in Ibibio Traditional Medicine”

Ibibio traditional medicine is the body of healing knowledge practiced by the Ibibio people of Akwa Ibom State in southern Nigeria. One of the most commonly used traditional medicines by the Ibibio people is the Vernonia amygdalina, commonly called bitter leaf due to the bitter taste of its leaf.
